metadata.description: Agent skill (open Agent Skills standard) that records browser videos (lectures, course replays, webinars) to MP4 for offline viewing with OBS on Windows.

plugins.name: browser-video-recorder
plugins.description: Record videos playing in a web browser to MP4 for offline viewing: finds every video from one course/playlist link, downloads what the site offers, records the rest in Edge/Chrome with OBS on Windows, unattended, with keep-awake, stall recovery, end detection, quality checks and optional silence trimming.
